newsitem.title: UK: One person injured in attack in N.Ireland.
newsitem.headline: One person injured in attack in N.Ireland.

text.p: One person was injured in a bomb attack on a police station in Northern Ireland, Britain's Press Association news agency reported on Wednesday night.
The attack came hours after two suspected IRA bombs exploded in northwest England, damaging railway tracks and signal boxes.
Press Association said witnesses had reported an explosion outside the police station in Coalisland, County Tyrone, shortly before 10 p.m. (2200 GMT).
But the injured man is believed to have been hurt by a plastic bullet fired by police after the blast, PA said.
He was not thought to be a member of the police or security forces. He was taken to hospital and was reported to be in a critical condition, PA said.
